Method of Attack: Authenticated options change vulnerability allowing attackers to connect their own Facebook Messenger account and intercept messages
Exploitation via wp_ajax_update_options AJAX action without proper authentication checks
Social engineering attacks by posing as site owner to request sensitive information
Hijacking site chat to ruin reputation or drive traffic to competitors
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using Facebook Chat Plugin
Attack Vector: Low-level authenticated user access to /wp-admin dashboard to update plugin options
Indicators of Compromise: Linked attacker Facebook Messenger account receiving site visitor messages
